text:
ashley: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem for Meridian. Summary: intermittent BGP peer resets from their on-prem router caused rapid session churn -> firewall session-table exhaustion -> our pod isolation by connection tracking. Need owners for fixes and short/med/long-term mitigations.

devon: i'll take short-term firewall/session tuning + verify conntrack limits on the edge appliances. what's their peak concurrent SYNs during the batch window? @marisol do you have metrics?

marisol: confirmed: baseline ~900 concurrent connections; batch window spikes to ~2.1k SYN/flows over ~4-7 minutes. SYN rps can hit 850/s for short bursts.

samir: i'll own the peering config changes. plan: bump BGP hold-time, add route flap damping for customer peer only, and add prefix-stability checks in our peering guard. will PR infra-configs.

kevin: i'll own staging repro + canary. plan to simulate their batch job pattern and measure session-table use and pod isolation thresholds. will script a synthetic generator.

ashley: putting action list here. i'll open a ticket and link.

ops-bot: Ticket INC-89211 created and linked to thread. Watchers: ashley, devon, samir, kevin, marisol.

ashley: ```
ACTIONS:
- A1 | Owner: devon | Due: 2026-04-04 | Increase conntrack table and reduce timeouts on edge appliances; add autoscaling for session-proxy where possible | Status: open
- A2 | Owner: samir | Due: 2026-03-31 | Apply customer-scoped BGP hold-time 240s + route-flap damping (half-life 300s); add config docs | Status: in review
- A3 | Owner: kevin | Due: 2026-04-09 | Run 3-day canary in staging reproducing 2x and 5x batch spikes; collect metrics and rollback plan | Status: todo
- A4 | Owner: ashley | Due: 2026-03-29 | Create monitoring eval for long-lived non-keepalive TCP sessions and SYN spike alert | Status: in progress
- A5 | Owner: marisol | Due: 2026-04-02 | Collect detailed packet captures from customer window and share sample pcap + summary | Status: pending
- A6 | Owner: devon | Due: 2026-04-07 | Add runbook step: temporary hold-time increase + rollback checklist for oncall | Status: todo
```

devon: quick config snippet prototype:
```
# conntrack sizing
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=600000
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=300
# ephemeral ports
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range=\"16000 61000\"
```

samir: note: route-flap damping should be applied narrowly. thresholds i suggest: suppress after 4 flaps within 2m; reuse time 600s; half-life 300s. will document rationale.

kevin: canary plan (short):
- step 0: deploy staging mirror of customer's vpc configs
- step 1: run baseline soak 2h
- step 2: inject synthetic batch spike (2.1k flows, then 5k in stress run)
- step 3: monitor conntrack, NAT ports, pod isolation logs, and automated rollback

marisol: I'll ask the customer for a sanitized pcap and confirm whether their edge has any asymmetric routing during batch window.

ashley: ops ask: add a detection for rapid-prefix-change events per peer (delta prefixes/min > X). who can take detection rule?

devon: i can add it with ashley. ACTION A7 created: Owner: devon + ashley | Due: 2026-03-30 | Prefix-change detector + alert and mitigation playbook | Status: open

ops-bot: Reminder: daily sync at 08:00 PT until A1..A6 closed.

kevin: observed pattern note: customers that don't use TCP keepalives and have short ephemeral port ranges hit exhaustion faster. we'll include guidance in customer comms.

marisol: Customer impact: intermittent queueing and 5-12s connection stalls during the worst spikes. no data loss but user-visible latency. i'll work with PM to prioritize maintenance slot.

ashley: thanks all. i'll post INC-89211 updates here after tomorrow's standup. keep comments short and tag owners when complete. :white_check_mark:
